KILL Proposal 2: fixed Plücker coordinates are merely additional linear column features. Unrestricted integral CVP coefficients are not constrained to be decomposable or to satisfy nonlinear Plücker relations, so the claimed curved-secant mechanism disappears and signed affine mixtures remain.

KILL Proposal 3: boundary scaling cannot charge exact cycles, while G7, G11/G13, G15, and G19 supply precisely the short signed structures that may become cycles. SNF and two small covers cannot establish an integral systole family, and no emitted CVP objective or completeness accounting is specified.

KILL Proposal 4: the product formula gives only sum-of-conjugates energy at least order D for a nonzero algebraic integer, not n^{Omega(1)} relative separation when D=Theta(log n). Units and exact field-linear kernels remain, and degree-4/8 testing cannot discriminate the claimed asymptotic weighted-conjugate law.

KILL Proposal 5: truncated path signatures are nonlinear in selected transitions unless replaced by a prefix-state expansion. That expansion must be explicitly polynomial-size and remains an unrestricted signed-flow system; neither the claimed exponential negative-support bound nor its advantage over the enlarged completeness baseline is specified.

KILL Proposal 6: its exact-fiber claim is incompatible with linear emitted checks. If honest window encodings h_i satisfy Ah_i=b, every integral affine combination sum c_i h_i with sum c_i=1 also satisfies the same checks, reproducing the G13/G15 obstruction regardless of expander distance.

The supplied G28 verifier reports lambda=57/32<mu=2, directly showing that one finite composition can worsen relative growth. G30 further reports an exact seed isometry, so tensor or lift language alone supplies no amplification.

The G14 verifier gives a finite pair-bag shell pass, but G15 reports an exact zero-residual affine lift through every tested hierarchy level. This supports rejecting Plücker and window claims that do not eliminate unrestricted affine mixtures.

The G19 verifier reports an exact accepting signed flow with two negative coefficients and only 16 anchor excess. Adding finite signature coordinates is therefore useful only after an explicit linear realization and an exact shell test.
No supplied verifier establishes a recurrence, uniform family, polynomial gap, large systole, number-field amplification, or exact honest-only fiber. All positive evidence is finite.
